vendor-key.note: The first calls used a still-valid cloud key issued to a vendor. The GitHub config file is where the key was found, not a commit on a Barracuda repository.

secret-chain.note: Secret-store reads, infrastructure-as-code state, and Kubernetes secret lists. Instance-metadata credential requests are a separate metadata hunt.

artex-match.note: Barracuda did not recover the tool. Resource names and probe order are a hunt clue, not a tool-call audit record.

ci-and-mount.note: The read-only host filesystem mount is the pod event. A short-lived branch that prints secrets into a build log is a CI event this pod query does not cover.
